Curriculum Issue / Vol. 01

The archive.

The concept / Explore the experience

Discover from a new angle.

Curriculum Issue reimagines education headlines as a three-dimensional, explorable world. Each floating paper is a doorway into a verified article. The experience is inspired by interactive visual storytelling, but the clippings and presentation are original to this prototype.

01 / DragDrag left or right to rotate through the news archive. On mobile, swipe.
02 / ExploreScroll, use your arrow keys, or the navigation arrows to move between stories.
03 / ReadClick a clipping to reveal the headline, summary and original news-source link.

Prototype note: The first clipping includes your supplied screenshot. Other clippings are original illustrative layouts based on verified headlines, not reproductions of publisher page screenshots.
